site.d23102d20914.message: Recipe identifiers, versions, engines, images, Chart requirements, hardware, GPU counts, and deployment topology.

site.08f10f6e0bd9.message: Complete YAML files committed to Git, their SHA-256 digests, Git commits, recipe release dates, and version history. Each configuration is checked against its SHA-256 digest after loading.
site.08f10f6e0bd9.description: 已提交的完整 YAML、其 SHA-256、Git 提交、配方发布日期与版本历史。配置加载后校验 SHA-256。

site.00399ee04cc5.message: The baseline and optimized versions explicitly linked to each tuning record, the recorded gain for each workload, and links to the original reports.
site.00399ee04cc5.description: 调优记录明确绑定的 baseline / optimized 版本、各负载的记录增幅及原报告链接。

site.7c00d2a02d83.message: Model, recipe, and comparison counts and model coverage come from the current catalog. The catalog includes simulated models; a model may have multiple comparisons.
site.7c00d2a02d83.description: 模型数、配方数、调优对照组数和覆盖模型比例，均由当前目录计数。目录包含模拟模型；同一模型可有多组对照。

site.aa876f41acd8.description: 经过规则解释，存在缺省或口径限制

site.d7fc8990d1a7.message: Throughput gain is the highest recorded percentage increase across a recipe’s workloads. Cards show the workload and the version used for measurement; sorting uses the same gain.
site.d7fc8990d1a7.description: “吞吐量提升”取该配方已记录负载中的最大百分比，卡片同时显示负载和测量版本；排序使用同一数值。

site.84db960e7e9a.message: Statistics use the latest measured version of each optimized recipe. Each comparison contributes its highest workload gain, or the recorded uplift if no workload breakdown is available. The median, range, and best gain are calculated from these values, excluding missing data. The best gain links to the corresponding recipe comparison.
site.84db960e7e9a.description: 统计卡按每个优化配方的最新测量版本逐组统计；每组取最佳负载增幅，没有分负载时取记录中的 uplift。中位数、范围与最佳提升均由这些有效值计算，缺失值不参与；最佳提升链接到对应配方的性能对照。

site.5b3136f9d600.message: If defaultVariant is missing, the first recipe is used as the default, following the source’s convention. “Default” does not mean “official baseline”.
site.5b3136f9d600.description: 缺少 defaultVariant 时，沿用来源约定，以第一套配方作为默认项；“默认”不表示“官方基线”。

site.1ec53c94e753.message: If topology is missing, the recipe is treated as single-node, following the source specification. Hardware names are abbreviated for display; full names remain in configurations and filters.
site.1ec53c94e753.description: 缺少拓扑时按源协议解释为单节点；硬件简称为展示转换，完整名称保留在配置与筛选中。

site.65db57ab0bba.message: Some reports normalize throughput to a fixed GPU count, even when the baseline and candidate use different numbers of GPUs. Interpret the figures alongside the original report and the versions used for measurement.
site.65db57ab0bba.description: 某些报告采用归一化到固定 GPU 数量的吞吐指标，baseline 与候选可能使用不同 GPU 数量。数值与测量版本按原报告阅读。

site.fbb2d8edf4c8.message: Recipe release dates come from Git commits, not benchmark runs. Neither the time of this retrieval nor the build baseline’s collection time indicates when the upstream data was validated.
site.fbb2d8edf4c8.description: 配方发布日期来自 Git 提交，不是压测日期；本次读取或基线采集时间也不是上游验证时间。

site.64cc3f646a04.message: Missing fields display “Not provided”; missing percentages are not replaced with zero. Only parameters explicitly included in the recipe are shown. None are inferred from its name.
site.64cc3f646a04.description: 字段缺失时显示“未提供”，百分比不以 0 补齐；参数仅展示配方明确包含的值，不根据配方名称补造。

site.e08e2dbf52df.description: 当前源数据没有，页面不补造

site.c5ec6c47649d.message: Catalog-wide production validation, hardware certification, CERTIFIED status, 100% official compatibility, and SLAs.
site.c5ec6c47649d.description: 全目录统一的生产验证、硬件适配认证、CERTIFIED、100% 官方适配和 SLA。

site.0a2e25346339.message: A single validated version across the catalog, real-time sync status, live service health, available cluster GPU inventory, and user sign-in.

site.938336e31cb7.message: Catalog-wide throughput medians or maxima under a unified methodology, and complete independent reproduction evidence.
site.938336e31cb7.description: 统一口径的全目录吞吐提升中位数 / 最高值结论和完整、独立复现证明。

site.7775290316ca.message: Design examples including Qwen H800 +29.3%, Kimi H200 CuTe +49.2%, DeepSeek Pro Ascend certification, and Qwen3.6-2.4T-A96B are not published as real records.
site.7775290316ca.description: 原设计中的 Qwen H800 +29.3%、Kimi H200 CuTe +49.2%、DeepSeek Pro Ascend 认证配方、Qwen3.6-2.4T-A96B，均不作为真实记录发布。

site.0534d9041172.message: Data currently comes from public GitHub Pages resources and raw files on GitHub. If loading fails, the versioned build baseline remains available with a retry option. The public source cannot retrieve arbitrary catalog snapshots. If a requested version cannot be restored, it is shown as unavailable rather than replaced with another version.
site.0534d9041172.description: 当前先使用公开 GitHub Pages / raw GitHub。读取失败保留带版本的构建基线，并提供重试。该公开源没有任意目录快照接口；无法恢复指定版本时显示不可用，不切换成其他版本。

site.51226c2de14d.message: 100% protection against stream interruptions caused by service crashes

site.5cf8fbac4dd2.message: Hang-Watcher out-of-band health checks within seconds:

site.0e6ae6afa50a.message: An independent, out-of-band probe monitors the engine’s token emission timestamps. If the wait for a token exceeds a dynamic threshold (for example, 150 ms, above the P99.9 latency), the node is marked as hung and a circuit breaker trips.
site.0e6ae6afa50a.description: 独立旁路探针实时监听引擎的 Token Emit 时间戳，若单 Token 生成等待时长超过动态阈值（如 150ms 超出 P99.9），立即将节点判定为 Hang 状态并下发熔断。

site.4fcc2464b707.message: The gateway caches tokens 1–N from the current stream. On node failure, it sends a continuation prefill request with the token history to a healthy node.
site.4fcc2464b707.description: 网关层实时缓存当前流式对话已吐出的 Token 1~N，并在检测到节点异常时，自动向健康节点发起包含历史 Token 的接续 Prefill 请求。

site.a42264b66b5c.description: 客户端 SSE 无感知透明接力：

site.b644cf4ef045.message: The browser or API client connection stays open. Output resumes at token N+1 without freezing the conversation or requiring a retry.
site.b644cf4ef045.description: 客户端浏览器或 API Client 的长连接永不中断，直接在 Token N+1 处无缝追加输出，前端对话 UI 毫无卡死与重试刷新感。

site.f3eb7665088b.message: The client maintains a persistent SSE connection; the gateway routes the request to
site.f3eb7665088b.description: 客户端保持 SSE 长连接；网关将请求分流至

site.0a3f56544d29.description: 突发故障 & 旁路探针捕获

site.554610a92c94.message: encounters a GPU memory deadlock or CUDA illegal memory access error, interrupting generation. Hang-Watcher detects a token emission timeout within 140 ms and tells the gateway to close its connection to A.
site.554610a92c94.description: 遭遇 GPU 显存死锁或 CUDA Illegal Memory Access，生成中断。Hang-Watcher 探针在 140ms 内检测到 Token Emit 超时，通知网关切断与 A 的通道。

site.77ee6098da09.message: Move beyond static TPM/RPM limits with real-time production feedback based on time to first token (TTFT) and output tokens per second (OTPS).
site.77ee6098da09.description: 告别单一粗暴的 TPM/RPM 静态限流，建立基于首字延迟 (TTFT) 与每秒产出 (OTPS) 的生产级实时反馈调控。

site.62dacb9461f9.message: Static rate limits cannot detect the cascading queues caused by saturated prefill capacity. ModelSphere monitors time to first token (TTFT). When it exceeds the threshold, the gateway responds within milliseconds with HTTP 429 and Retry-After: 120ms to prompt client backoff and prevent cluster overload.
site.62dacb9461f9.description: 静态限流无法感知 Prefill 算力饱和引发的排队雪崩。ModelSphere 动态监测首字延迟。当 TTFT 突破阈值时，网关在毫秒级返回携带 Retry-After: 120ms 的智能 429 退避，避免集群被拖死。

site.69fb535284fa.message: Adjust inference Pod replicas within milliseconds as concurrency changes. During off-peak hours, high-priority models use idle accelerators, raising overall GPU utilization from the industry average of 45% to over 85% in this design example. In-flight requests finish before replicas are released during scale-down.
site.69fb535284fa.description: 随并发需求毫秒级调整推理 Pod 副本；非高峰期高优模型借用闲置芯片，使集群整体 GPU 利用率从行业平均 45% 大幅跃升至 85% 以上，且缩容时保证就绪请求排空再释放。
